notes.title: Feb. 2021 Small Update
notes.content:
This is a small update to improve game look and feel:


Added a new song playing in the title screen, intro and tutorial
Added new backgrounds in the title screen and intro

notes.title: Gamepad support + tutorial + shake + new enemies + more!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Merry Xmas (late) and Happy New Year!

For this second update I am bringing some extra basic stuff to the game as follows:

Gamepad support
You can now play the game using your favorite gamepad. It has full support for the main controllers.

Tutorial
You can now see the main rules of the game just before starting a match. In the same screen you can check the controls scheme.

Shake effect and zoom
Now when you hit something you will experience a shake effect. Also, the camera will zoom out the character according to the running speed. This increases the game immersion.

New enemies
2 new types of police cars will hunt you down. One of them is bigger, with a bigger area to avoid. They also hover now, so it is something else to pay attention.

Other stuff
I have changed the light post visuals. Also fixed some menus. Fixed some errors on the backgrounds.

Have fun!

notes.title: Configurations + pause menu + introduction
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

All Indigo Arts games are updated regularly. This is the first for Cybergeist, so I wanted to make it more rich before including extra contents to it.

I decided to add:


Included configurations for sound (enabled or not), fullscreen or windowed mode and sound volume
Included pause menu (you can use it for a break, to restart the game or to exit for the title screen
Included a introduction history. The same history you can find here on the game page. It will be improved on next updates


Thank you all for your support!
